image_description: A fireboat (marked 'PILOT' and 'K348') on water, actively spraying a powerful jet of water from a bow-mounted water cannon. The vessel has a black hull with a red stripe, white superstructure, and green deck. It features a wheelhouse with large windows, a mast with signal flags, and fenders (tires) along the hull. Several people are visible on deck.
